description: This file defines a Go struct 'ProbeHandlerApplyConfiguration' for declarative configuration of Kubernetes probe handlers, including methods for setting different probe actions and constructing the configuration.

classes.name: ProbeHandlerApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing a declarative configuration for a Kubernetes probe handler, with optional fields for exec, HTTPGet, TCPSocket, and GRPC actions.
